source_snapshot.procedure: Check an x16 device in BIOS Setup, UEFI `pci`/`pci -i` and Linux `lspci -vvv`; compare speed/width; source also asks to clear logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Device information correct across BIOS/UEFI/OS; link status and speed match SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: PCIe Slot; pciutils; 5 attended/10 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES; plain Linux `lspci` only, omitting BIOS, UEFI, x16 physical mapping and verbose link state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; required exact slot topology, endpoint identity, complete `lspci -Dnnvvv`, firmware evidence and per-segment speed/width/error oracle.

old_problem: The historical record treated physical slot/BDF topology, x16 semantics and cross-environment oracle as an Engineering Decision although they are project runtime bindings for a standard read-only PCIe validation method.
disposition_reason: Standard BIOS/UEFI/PCIe/Linux enumeration and PCIe capability versus negotiated-link semantics are established. ED-03/05/07/08 allow the board-specific slot/riser/root-port/switch/retimer/BDF map and required generation/width as runtime configuration. Firmware surfaces require operator evidence; missing bindings block execution, not review design.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2195, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2196 / Wistron-HW-00477-V002 / a33ee384a79b49f2 was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Bind chassis slot/riser/root-port/switch/retimer to endpoint PN/serial/device ID/BDF; BDF alone is not physical identity.
Define whether x16 means connector capability, wired lanes or required negotiated width and specify generation/width for every relevant segment.
Operator captures BIOS Setup and UEFI `pci -i`; Linux collection uses complete domain-qualified `lspci -Dnnvvv` plus bridge/AER context.
Compare capability and negotiated state at an approved power/read point; preserve logs and do not clear AER evidence.
No BIOS change, device reset, link retrain, power action or automatic retry.
No firmware navigation, command, reset, retrain or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Parameterized BIOS, UEFI and Linux physical x16 PCIe slot/link validation
test_case.purpose: Prove the designated physical PCIe slot and stable endpoint are consistently present across BIOS, UEFI and Linux and every required link segment negotiates the signed generation/width without errors.
required_package: Endpoint PN/serial/device/BDF and per-segment gen/width oracle
BIOS Setup and UEFI console/operator evidence
test_case.test_command: After topology and target confirmation, operator captures the exact endpoint in BIOS Setup and UEFI `pci -i`; collect complete Linux `lspci -Dnnvvv` for endpoint and bridge chain plus read-only AER/kernel/SEL context. Compare stable identity, capability and negotiated generation/width at every signed segment without changing or retraining links.
test_case.expected_result: The same signed endpoint appears in the designated physical path on all three surfaces, every required segment meets its capability/negotiated generation and width oracle, drivers remain healthy and no prohibited PCIe error occurs.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when physical mapping, BIOS/UEFI/Linux identity and all per-segment link/error criteria match. Missing/wrong endpoint, bridge mismatch, downgrade or disallowed AER is FAIL. Missing runtime topology/spec or firmware evidence is BLOCKED, never assumed PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact topology, endpoint, link oracle, read point, access and authorization are signed.
Read-only enumeration only; preserve existing AER/kernel/SEL evidence.
No BIOS change, reset, retrain, power action, log clearing or automatic retry.
Stop on host/endpoint ambiguity, missing path, downgrade, AER or instability.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/BIOS identity
Signed physical-to-logical topology and endpoint stable identity
Preserved AER/kernel/SEL/boot evidence and tool versions
test_case.recovery: Read-only evidence changes no DUT state. Stop on mismatch, preserve raw artifacts and escalate; do not change BIOS, reset/retrain, clear logs, power-cycle or retry to alter the result.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require physical x16 slot/link validation across BIOS, UEFI and OS; DeepSeek is merely incomplete.

blocked.reason: Standard PCIe method is clear; board topology and link limits are runtime project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Platform/BIOS identity, slot-to-endpoint topology, x16/gen/width semantics, firmware fields, Linux target, read-point tolerance and AER limits.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED HYBRID TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND USER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO FIRMWARE, COMMAND, RESET, RETRAIN, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign topology/link oracle and evidence surfaces before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.
